items.title: An infinite family with one-sided l1-approximate cut dimension 2n minus 2
items.author: Troy Lee; Tongyang Li; Miklos Santha; Shengyu Zhang
items.source_version: Complete CC BY-NC-SA4.0 author manuscript arxiv2011.05085v2,2020-11-27; original unnumberedSection7 construction for n=3k+1, underlying authorTheorem3 proof
items.difficulty_reason: The authors allow cut vectors to decrease within weight-dependent error budgets, then prove a full-rank lower bound for every such perturbation using block elimination, a partner-column constraint and a diagonal-dominance argument in the K4 direct-union construction.

primary.label: Original author infinite-family approximate-cut-dimension statement for n=3k+1

proof_spans.label: Entire original Section7 proof, K4 diagrams/base case, partner-property lemma and arbitrary-k rank construction
